messages:
Ethan P.: Heads-up — we closed an EAP with Verdant Compute for a small on-prem + cloud marketplace preview. They want a coordinated bench + marketplace listing pilot. Need NDA final, bench plan, and joint announcement window. Who can drive ops?
Jia W.: I can run the bench harness and ops for the first 2 weeks. what hardware they giving us?
Ethan P.: Verdant will provide 8x A200 nodes in their lab + 4x p4d for cloud parity. NDA draft from legal is attached: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake/verdant-eap-nda (placeholder).
Maya R.: For the bench, let's capture perf (p90 latency, tokens/sec), memory footprint, and tail when we hit KV-cache stress. Also collect logs for OOM/CUDA errors.
Sam O.: I'll add SRE telemetry hooks and a prs with export config. We should ship a lightweight prometheus + loki stack for the lab tests.
Linda M.: Marketing wants a joint press window but understands we can't announce until NDA + compatibility checks pass. Timeline request: internal readiness by 4/12, partner review 4/19, joint announcement earliest 4/26. Is that realistic? :calendar:
Ethan P.: 4/26 is probably okay if benching + fixes are quick. Need legal sign-off by 4/5 to start lab access.
Jia W.: Ops checklist I need: lab ssh creds, docker image + model artifact, kv-cache toggles, runbook for failed nodes. Can Verdant do a jump-host?
Ethan P.: Verdant confirmed jump-host. I'll coordinate keys.
Maya R.: Proposed bench command (simple harness):
```
PYTHONPATH=./bench python run_bench.py --model redwood-v1 --batch 8 --seq 2048 --profile 
```
Capture: `--profile` outputs p90/p99 and token/sec.
Sam O.: I'll stub prometheus metrics endpoint: `/metrics/bench` and a grafana dashboard. Please call out metric labels: `node_id`, `model_version`, `seq_len`, `cache_mode`.
Linda M.: For marketplace listing we need: approved marketing blurbs, logo assets, partner legal asset list, and a launch checklist 72h out. Also confirm if Verdant requires co-brand review.
Ethan P.: They require co-brand review and an embargoed blurb. Partner legal asked for a short SSO addendum for access.
PartnerBot: Reminder: NDA draft v3 uploaded by legal@redwood at 1739039000. Review link: https://legal.redwood.example/nda/verdant/v3
Jia W.: Risk notes: their lab runs older drivers on two nodes. I'll run a driver check script first to avoid noisy flakes.
Maya R.: Add a qualitative evalset to the bench (100 prompts) so we can surface any regression after quant/ops changes.
Sam O.: On rollback strategy: if cloud p4d latencies deviate >20% vs lab A200 baseline, auto-fallback to lighter quantized model in prod routing. I'll add a routing policy to the config.
Linda M.: Copying partner marketing: @Verdant_Marketing (they're in their own workspace). We'll do a mutual review of final copy 48h before announce.
Ethan P.: Action list: 
- Ethan: get NDA signed by 4/5 (owner)
- Jia: bench harness + driver-check script by 4/9
- Sam: telemetry + rollback policy by 4/11
- Maya: qualitative evalset + failure mode doc by 4/11
- Linda: draft co-branded announcement + checklist by 4/18
If any blockers ping me.
Jia W.: I'll create the bench repo and ping for access.
Sam O.: provisioning ticket filed (#INC-4491) for jump-host + prometheus.
Linda M.: Noted, will schedule partner review meeting for 4/20.
Ethan P.: Thanks team. Keeping this thread as single source for the EAP -> marketplace launch. Will post updates here. :thumbsup:
